adapter_provenance.method: Independent dispositions and dimension rationales copied unchanged; source paths bound to evidence IDs

reliability.rationale: Exact states reproduce all saved predictions and complete-group errors; adverse comparators remain included.

mechanism.rationale: Computational agreement alone does not establish the proposed physical mechanism.

novelty.rationale: This computational review does not adjudicate literature priority.

significance.rationale: The task is a usable numerical comparison within its measured-system contract. One held heating-rate program on one source material; fitted channels are not independently identified chemical species.

reproducibility.rationale: Native assets, deterministic parser, exact frozen state and independent arithmetic agree in this review.

impact.rationale: No independent operational intervention or cost/reliability outcome is measured.

checks: Independent native reconstruction agrees with frozen predictors, targets and complete-group identities
No group crosses development/confirmation; source hashes checked by deterministic parser
Every saved equation independently executed and every group-balanced MAE recomputed using NumPy/pandas
No fitting, network or history imports in prediction function
All confirmation samples come from the20 K/min trace; conversion constrained to0..1
Source native reader selects observed columns only; fitted columns not targets
limitations: One held heating-rate program on one source material; fitted channels are not independently identified chemical species.
